title: Lead AI Architect
description:
Lead AI Architect

London (Hybrid, 3 days in office) | £120,000 - £170,000 + Benefits

This is a rare opportunity for a Lead AI Architect to shape the AI strategy of a large, data-driven organisation investing heavily in AI innovation. You'll have significant influence over enterprise architecture decisions, helping build the foundations for scalable AI products and platforms.

The Company

They are a global organisation undergoing significant growth across Data & AI, with strong investment in AI, technology and innovation. Having established a modern data platform, the focus is now on building enterprise AI capabilities that can be adopted at scale across the business.

The Role

You will define and drive the AI architecture strategy, standards and roadmap across the organisation.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Defining enterprise AI architecture principles, standards and governance
  • Designing scalable architectures across Generative AI, Agentic AI and machine learning initiatives
  • Establishing best practices for AI platforms, LLMOps, MLOps and AI observability
  • Developing reference architectures, guardrails and design patterns
  • Driving architecture decisions for AI platforms, models and orchestration frameworks
  • Partnering with technology, security, risk and business stakeholders to align AI strategy with wider business objectives
  • Providing technical leadership on the design and scaling of enterprise AI solutions

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in AI Architecture, Data Architecture, Data Engineering or Enterprise Architecture
  • Proven experience defining enterprise-wide AI strategy and architecture
  • Expertise in Generative AI, LLMs and AI platform design
  • Experience with Agentic AI, orchestration frameworks, MLOps and LLMOps
  • Background building AI, data or machine learning platforms within complex organisations
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders
  • Experience with platforms such as Databricks and foundation models including OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini

What They Offer

  • £120,000 - £170,000 base salary
  • Competitive benefits package
  • Hybrid working model
  • Opportunity to become the most senior AI Architect in the organisation
  • Significant influence over AI strategy and technology direction
  • Exposure to large-scale, enterprise AI transformation programmes
  • Clear progression within a rapidly growing Data & AI function

How to Apply

If you're an experienced AI Architect looking to shape the future of enterprise AI within a complex, technology-driven environment, apply today to learn more.
